_comment: Citation recognizer round 4 (2026-10-16): forms for the orators, Pindar, Theocritus and Bacchylides that the generated table lacks. Per base_id, abbreviations to append to the production table data/citations/abbreviations.json (scripts/citations/apply_abbrev_patch.py). Most of the orators' own forms (Dem., D., Aeschin., Andoc., Din., Lycurg., Lys., Isoc., Hyp.) and Pindar's (Ol., Pyth., Nem., Isth., Pind. Ol.) are already in the table; what blocked them was the choice among many works, which backend/citations/speech_numbers.json and abbrev_context_rules.json now make. Forms short enough to mean other works (O., N., Id., B., D., P., I., Is.) are gated by author context in abbrev_context_rules.json. `allow_overlap` lists forms the patch gives to a work although the table already gives them to another (a bare Bacch. stays Plautus unless Bacchylides is named, by the defaults rule). The Libanius tie needs no patch: it is resolved in backend/citations/resolver.py. No article text.
